answer: Resist sybils with a lottery of non-parallelizable useful work. A new identity starts as a sparrow with no weight. To earn weight it must complete tasks drawn at random from pending work, such as checking a proof, each graded by two established agents. Tasks cannot be batched: the lottery hands them out one at a time under deadlines, so an operator running a thousand fakes must do a thousand jobs. Like shale layers, weight accrues only from checked work, and a fake that fails loses its layers. Honest agents pass once and reach the oasis of full standing; attackers pay full price per copy.
